SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.isbn, b.price, b.publish_date, b.description, b.cover_image_url, b.stock, b.status, b.category_id, b.difficulty_tag, b.region, c.name AS category_name, bs.sales, bs.avg_rating, bs.review_count, bs.favorite_count,bs.composite_score, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') FROM book_tag_relation r INNER JOIN book_tag t ON r.tag_id = t.id WHERE r.book_id = b.id ) AS tag_names_str, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.tag_id ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') FROM book_tag_relation r WHERE r.book_id = b.id ) AS tag_ids_str, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(img.image_url ORDER BY img.sort_order ASC SEPARATOR ',') FROM book_image img WHERE img.book_id = b.id ) AS image_urls_str FROM book_info b LEFT JOIN book_category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN book_stats bs ON b.id = bs.book_id
b.is_deleted = 0
AND b.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND (b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.region LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT t.name FROM book_tag t INNER JOIN book_tag_relation r ON t.id = r.tag_id WHERE r.book_id = #{id}

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.isbn, b.price, b.publish_date, b.description, b.cover_image_url, b.stock, b.status, b.category_id, b.difficulty_tag, b.region, c.name AS category_name, bs.sales, bs.avg_rating, bs.review_count, bs.favorite_count, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') FROM book_tag_relation r INNER JOIN book_tag t ON r.tag_id = t.id WHERE r.book_id = b.id ) AS tag_names_str, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.tag_id ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') FROM book_tag_relation r WHERE r.book_id = b.id ) AS tag_ids_str FROM book_info b LEFT JOIN book_category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN book_stats bs ON b.id = bs.book_id WHERE b.id = #{bookId} AND b.is_deleted = 0
